text:
ops-bot: Incident detected: ctrl-plane auth service in us-west2 returning 503 for token introspect. Affected: console auth, config rollouts, routing decisions. Alert ID: INC-2026-345.

maria: seeing console 401s too, can't list clusters. CLI auth fails with "token validation error".

leo: confirmed. Control plane API east/west split: west control-plane auth endpoints timing out, traffic is degrading routing decisions for us-west serving nodes.

sre-oncall: activating control-plane runbook step 1. Starting auth-service restart on west2 control-plane primaries.

david: any impact to serving nodes? Are model hosts rejecting connections?

maria: serving still accepts tokens if already cached, but new sign-ins fail. KV cache TTL is 5m, expiring clients hit auth endpoint.

infra-bot: autoscaler report: us-west2 GPU pool at 98% reserved capacity; can't absorb traffic spikes by spinning new nodes.

sre-oncall: task list: 1) rotate auth-service pods, 2) bump routing fallback to us-central1 for new requests, 3) notify Support and customers on Dedicated plans.

leo: preparing a routing override. Will change smart-routing policy to prefer us-central1 for customers with no region pinning. Will keep pinned customers on current nodes.

maria: if we shift traffic we'll trigger cross-region egress costs and added latency for eu customers. Need to limit to non-EU tenancy.

david: also watch token revocation — if we rotate signing key it'll invalidate sessions. Do NOT rotate keys until rollback plan confirmed.

sre-oncall: agreed. No key rotations. Only pod restart and leader failover.

ops-bot: Command executed: kubectl -n redwood-system rollout restart deployment/auth-service --context=west2-controlplane

maria: logs show auth-service re-entering Ready state on two primaries. Still ~15% requests 5xx.

leo: routing override staged. PATCH /routing/policies/active -> set prefer_regions=[us-central1] for policy smart_default (dry-run=false)

infra-bot: note: us-central GPU pool usage 72% after staged traffic. Batching likely to help — Suggest enabling conservative batching for open hosted API keys for 30s window.

support-joe: IM'ing top 5 affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA 45m. Posting status update to status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-345

david: to ops: can we enable prefix KV caching extension for auth tokens to reduce hits? quick patch available: enable AUTH_KV_CACHE_TTL=300 -> 900

sre-oncall: applied AUTH_KV_CACHE_TTL=900 in west2 control-plane via configmap patch. Monitoring.

maria: errors down to ~2% now, console access restoring for most users. Rolling restarts completed.

ops-bot: Incident status: partial mitigation achieved. Traffic shifted for unpinned customers. Monitoring metrics: auth_5xx decreased, routing_latency normalized.

support-joe: posted update on customers + internal comms. Will continue to monitor and prepare RCA draft.

leo: next steps: 1) run thorough config rollout checks across control-plane clusters, 2) evaluate autoscaler thresholds for west2 GPU pool, 3) cost analysis for cross-region shifts.

sre-oncall: leaving this open as P1 for 6h. Assigning followups to infra and capacity planning.

maria: thanks team. If we see reappearance of 5xx within 1h, escalate to ENG-Runtime.

ops-bot: INC-2026-345 status set to "monitoring". Channel will be archived after RCA.
